description: This file contains helper functions and logic for handling MCP-aware chat completion requests, including building call arguments, managing MCP tool processing, and orchestrating asynchronous completion calls.

classes.name: CompletionCallable
classes.description: Type alias for a callable that performs an asynchronous completion, returning either a ModelResponse or CustomStreamWrapper.

methods.name: _build_call_args_from_context
methods.description: Builds a dictionary of call arguments for the completion function based on a provided call context.

methods.name: _call_acompletion_internal
methods.description: Invokes the completion callable while skipping MCP interception to prevent recursion.

methods.name: handle_chat_completion_with_mcp
methods.description: Main function to handle MCP-enabled chat completion requests, managing tool processing, headers, and response orchestration.
